A 探针完整输入文件 cli_probe.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Exercise the built corrector CLI with fresh inputs and assert its output.\"\"\"\nimport pathlib\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\n\n\nbinary = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])\nscenario = sys.argv[2]\ncases = {\n    \"direction\": ([\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"], [\"A\", \"C\"], [\n        \"distance: 1\",\n        'I 1 \"B\"',\n    ]),\n    \"duplicates\": ([\"A\", \"A\"], [\"A\"], [\n        \"distance: 1\",\n        'I 0 \"A\"',\n    ]),\n    \"mixed\": ([\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"], [\"A\", \"X\", \"C\"], [\n        \"distance: 2\",\n        'D 1 \"X\"',\n        'I 1 \"B\"',\n    ]),\n}\nexpected, scanned, evidence = cases[scenario]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"corrector-probe-\") as temp:\n    root = pathlib.Path(temp)\n    (root / \"expected.txt\").write_text(\"\".join(item + \"\\n\" for item in expected))\n    (root / \"scanned.txt\").write_text(\"\".join(item + \"\\n\" for item in scanned))\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [str(binary), \"-expected\", str(root / \"expected.txt\"), \"-scanned\", str(root / \"scanned.txt\")],\n        text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=10,\n    )\n    print(result.stdout, end=\"\")\n    if result.stderr:\n        print(result.stderr, end=\"\", file=sys.stderr)\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"CLI exited {result.returncode}\")\n    missing = [line for line in evidence if line not in result.stdout.splitlines()]\n    if missing:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"missing actual CLI evidence: {missing}\")\n    print(f\"verified: exit={result.returncode}; replay input={scanned}; expected={expected}\")\n"

A 探针完整输入文件 warmup.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Prepare the CLI and Go test cache in this support directory.\"\"\"\nimport os\nimport pathlib\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nworkspace = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()\nsupport = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()\ngo = \"/usr/local/go/bin/go\"\nenv = os.environ.copy()\nenv[\"GOCACHE\"] = str(support / \".gocache\")\n(support / \".gocache\").mkdir(exist_ok=True)\nversion = subprocess.run([go, \"version\"], check=True, text=True, capture_output=True)\nprint(version.stdout.strip())\nif \"go1.27.1\" not in version.stdout:\n    raise SystemExit(\"Go toolchain does not match go.mod requirement 1.27.1\")\nfor command in (\n    [go, \"-C\", str(workspace), \"build\", \"-o\", str(support / \"corrector\"), \"./cmd/corrector\"],\n    [go, \"-C\", str(workspace), \"test\", \"-run\", \"^$\", \"-count=1\", \".\"],\n):\n    result = subprocess.run(command, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)\n    if result.stdout:\n        print(result.stdout, end=\"\")\n    if result.stderr:\n        print(result.stderr, end=\"\", file=sys.stderr)\n    if result.returncode:\n        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)\nprint(\"CLI build and test compilation completed\")\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 probe.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport pathlib\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\n\nmode, support = sys.argv[1], pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()\nbinary = support / \"scanalign\"\n\ndef run(args, data=\"\"):\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(binary), *args], input=data, text=True,\n        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=10,\n    )\n\nif mode == \"stdin-edits\":\n    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=support) as tmp:\n        expected = pathlib.Path(tmp) / \"expected.txt\"\n        expected.write_text(\"a\\nb\\nc\\n\")\n        r = run([\"-edits-only\", str(expected), \"-\"], \"a\\nx\\nc\\n\")\n    if r.returncode != 0 or r.stdout != \"del b\\nins x\\n\" or \"distance: 2 (del: 1, ins: 1)\" not in r.stderr:\n        print(f\"stdin-edits mismatch: code={r.returncode} stdout={r.stdout!r} stderr={r.stderr!r}\")\n        raise SystemExit(1)\n    print(\"stdin + -edits-only: exit=0\")\n    print(\"actual edits: \" + \" | \".join(r.stdout.strip().splitlines()))\n    print(\"actual summary: \" + r.stderr.strip())\nelif mode == \"input-errors\":\n    both = run([\"-\", \"-\"], \"\")\n    missing = run([str(support / \"no-such-input.txt\"), str(support / \"also-missing.txt\")])\n    if both.returncode != 2 or \"only one input may be stdin\" not in both.stderr:\n        print(f\"double-stdin mismatch: code={both.returncode} stderr={both.stderr!r}\")\n        raise SystemExit(1)\n    if missing.returncode != 1 or \"scanalign:\" not in missing.stderr:\n        print(f\"missing-file mismatch: code={missing.returncode} stderr={missing.stderr!r}\")\n        raise SystemExit(1)\n    print(f\"two stdin inputs: exit={both.returncode}; {both.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1]}\")\n    print(f\"missing file: exit={missing.returncode}; {missing.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1]}\")\nelse:\n    raise SystemExit(\"unknown probe mode\")\n"

B 探针完整输入文件 warmup.py以 JSON 字符串记录，解码后可还原完整输入文件："#!/usr/bin/env python3\nimport os\nimport pathlib\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nworkspace = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])\nsupport = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()\ncache = support / \"gocache\"\nbinary = support / \"scanalign\"\nenv = os.environ.copy()\nenv[\"GOCACHE\"] = str(cache)\nresult = subprocess.run(\n    [\"/usr/local/go/bin/go\", \"build\", \"-o\", str(binary), \"./cmd/scanalign\"],\n    cwd=workspace,\n    env=env,\n    text=True,\n    stdout=subprocess.PIPE,\n    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,\n    timeout=120,\n)\nif result.stdout:\n    print(result.stdout, end=\"\" if result.stdout.endswith(\"\\n\") else \"\\n\")\nif result.returncode:\n    raise SystemExit(result.returncode)\nprint(f\"warm build: exit={result.returncode}; binary ready\")\n"
